snippet.title: Hello Kitty Party Land - Guided Tour
snippet.description:
🎀 The latest trailer for Hello Kitty Party Land is here!
 
Join your favourite SANRIO characters on exciting adventures, enjoying a variety of activities like growing fruits and vegetables, fishing, creating artwork, and designing your own outfits. With over 45 fun mini-games to play, there’s something for everyone!
 
Head over to the adorable party world and create your very own joyful moments! ✨
 
Hello Kitty Party Land is coming to Nintendo Switch™ 2 and Nintendo Switch™ on 29 October!
